thread:
morgan: Heads-up — starting integration plan for FlashX (v2/v3) today. Goal: safe canary that lets chooser pick best kernel by shape and fall back to paged-attn when memory spikes. Posting notes & a quick rollout config.

kai: SGTM. Do we have perf baselines for 512/2048/8192 sequence lengths on A100 and H100?

sophia: Uploaded a small perf dump to the profiling bucket: https://s3.redwood/profiler/flashx/241234. TL;DR: v3 wins 2–3x p95 for 512/2048 in fused path, but 8192 shows KV pressure and some regressions w/ large batch sizes.

morgan: Nice. Key takeaways: 1) chooser rules should prefer v3 for short/med seq and fused path allowed. 2) for >4096 or when mem headroom < 20% prefer v2 or paged-attn. 3) throttle batching for v3 when batch_size>16 to avoid OOMs.

devon: Can we implement a runtime heuristic: if (seq_len*batch_token_estimate > kernel_mem_threshold) then route to paged-attn? Where kernel_mem_threshold is runtime-reported per-GPU.

kai: yes — we already expose GPU free mem and model KV footprint per model-version. plan: chooser score = latency_est / cost_est + oom_penalty; oom_penalty = 1000 when estimated_mem > free_mem*0.8.

sophia: Also saw KV cache thrashing on long chats with streaming. Recommend small LRU TTL for prefix cache and keep recent N segments pinned for 1s. Without that, we saw 12% higher p99 tail.

morgan: putting a feature flag: attn_flashx_enabled with rollout percentages. Suggested rollout: 1% (smoke) -> 10% (short seq) -> 30% (mixed) -> 100 with auto-fallback.

morgan: Flag config snippet: ```json
{"flag": "attn_flashx_enabled", "phases": [{"pct":1, "query":"all"}, {"pct":10, "query":"seq_len<=1024"}, {"pct":30, "query":"seq_len<=4096"}], "auto_fallback": true}```

kai: Add health checks: error-rate > 0.5% for 5m or p99 latency increase > 25% triggers immediate scale-down and remove flag for affected pool. Also log chosen_kernel + reason in trace.

perf-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for attn-chooser v0.9 to pool-us-west-2-g1 (1% traffic). Monitor: /dash/attn-chooser/241234.

morgan: We'll run targeted perf jobs: KV-heavy replay, streaming chat, short-completion. Sophia, can you run KV replay and paste results later?

sophia: On it. Initial KV replay: v3 fused 512/1kb batches good. For 8192, v3 hit 18% p95 regression vs v2 at batch 8. Details in the dump.

devon: Ops question: do we need kernel compile variants (ftz vs no-ftz) toggles? Might reduce numerics regressions.

kai: yes — include a narrow kernel flagset per model: {"ftz":true/false, "mixed_prec":true/false, "paged_prefetch":true/false}. Default to safe (ftz=false) for enterprise tiers.

morgan: Action items: 1) kai implement chooser heuristics + trace logging (ETA 1d). 2) devon add mem_threshold routing + rollout gating (ETA 2d). 3) sophia run replay tests and post artifacts (ETA EOD). 4) ops monitor dashboards and hold rollback runbook.

morgan: tagging @kai @sophia @devon — keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
